title: Q-YEAR-SIM-model-retirement: capacity stays at 0.85 after it, for good
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the year simulation (YEAR-SIM-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe model-retirement
**Status:** closed

Fault class `model-retirement`: capacity stays at 0.85 after it, for good. Drill evidence: 5 vendor-wide retirements through agents.complete: 5 still produced a change; model-refresh-host is open: source keeps naming the retired id, one rung lost per batch

Build the mechanism that recovers from it without a person, then the drill in foundation/yearsim.py must exercise it.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe model-retirement` exits 0.

**Evidence:** year simulation at 2026-11-21T11:09:16Z: 8 vendor-wide retirements through agents.complete: 8 still produced a change, 1 on a healed rung; modelwatch.observed turned 1 recorded 410s into catalog retirements; watchdog runs it: True
